business.name: Ridgeline Home Services
business.tagline: Sample Data — Replace Before Any Client Build
business.pitch: This is the demo record the template ships with so it builds and previews out of the box. Replace the whole file with the client's own site-data.json.

about.story: Sample owner story. The real one comes from the client intake and is written by the delivery routine, not by hand in this file. It runs a few sentences and explains who runs the business and how they work.

seo.description: Sample meta description for the WarleyD client site template. Replace this file with real client data before building any client site.

home.aboutParagraph: Sample home-page intro paragraph. This is where the business explains, in its own words, what it does and the area it covers. The delivery routine writes this from the client's intake.
ctaBullets: Sample bullet one — a real reason to call this business
Sample bullet two — something the intake actually supports
Sample bullet three — no invented claims

services.name: Sample Service One
services.description: One-line description of the first service, as it appears on the service card.

detail.intro: Sample intro paragraph for this service page. The real copy explains the work in the client's own voice, references the local area, and is long enough to carry the page on its own.
whatsIncluded: Sample line describing something included in the job
Sample line describing another included item
Sample line describing a third included item
process: Sample step one of how the work is carried out
Sample step two of how the work is carried out
Sample step three of how the work is carried out
commonSigns: Sample sign that a customer needs this service
Sample second sign a customer might recognise

faq.a: Sample answer. Real answers are specific, local, and honest about what the business will and will not do.

services.name: Sample Service Two
services.description: One-line description of the second service, as it appears on the service card.

detail.intro: Sample intro paragraph for the second service page. Each service gets its own unique body copy so no two routes in the built site are ever the same.
whatsIncluded: Sample included item for the second service
process: Sample step one for the second service
Sample step two for the second service
commonSigns: Sample sign relevant to the second service

faq.q: Sample question about the second service?
faq.a: Sample answer for the second service, distinct from every other answer in the file.

locations.body: Sample city page body copy for the primary city. Real location copy references streets, housing stock, soil, and the conditions that actually shape the work in that place, and it is unique to this city.
Sample city page body copy for the second area. It must differ from every other location entry — duplicate city pages are the fastest way to get a small local site ignored by search engines.

sections: Sample about-page section one. The delivery routine writes four of these from the intake, covering who the business is and how it got started.
Sample about-page section two, covering how the business approaches its work and what it will not take on.
Sample about-page section three, covering what happens when a customer first makes contact.
Sample about-page section four, covering why a customer would choose this business over the next one.

faq.q: Sample trade-level question that spans all services?
faq.a: Sample answer. These appear on the services index page and feed the FAQPage structured data.

contact.responseLine: Sample contact response line describing how to get in touch and what happens next. It should promise only what the business actually does.
expectBullets: Sample step one of what a customer can expect after making contact
